summary.text: Steven Kraus is an independent write-in candidate for Ohio House District 89 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He previously represented the district as a Republican from 2014 to 2015.

paragraphs.text: Kraus is a real estate agent and auctioneer who attended Sandusky High School, earned a bachelor's degree from Troy State University, and served in the U.S. Air Force, according to Ballotpedia.
He lost the March 2012 Republican primary for Ohio's 9th Congressional District to Samuel Wurzelbacher, 48.6 percent to 51.4 percent.
Kraus won the Ohio House District 89 seat in the November 2014 general election, defeating incumbent Chris Redfern, and left office on July 27, 2015.
In 2015 he served on the Agriculture and Rural Development; Armed Services, Veterans Affairs and Public Safety; and Economic and Workforce Development committees.
He was the Republican nominee for Ohio's 9th Congressional District in 2018 and lost to Marcy Kaptur, 67.8 percent to 32.2 percent.
In the March 19, 2024 Republican primary for House District 89, he received 34.8 percent of the vote to incumbent D.J. Swearingen's 65.2 percent.
